summary: Describes how the ITU-T and the ISOC and IETF collaborate on standards work. It sets out the process for the two organizations to coordinate. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 3356.

eli5.summary: Two big groups that write rules for communication agreed on how to work together so they do not make clashing rules.

questions: how do the ietf and itu-t collaborate
what is the isoc ietf itu-t collaboration process
